method: Preserved actual command outputs. Unit/review/evidence preceded the final responsive CSS and browser harness changes; pure simulation and policy sources remain unchanged. The final freeze build passed product and tool TypeScript and Vite, followed by check:dist. Browser runtime verification and latest-head CI are recorded separately.
